started out in ''[https://www.hltv.org/player/9373/johnqt#tab-matchesBox Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]'' where he played in various local tournaments. Eventually finding himself on [[Viboras]]. However in 2020 he would make a switch to VALORANT under the team, and started appearing in ''North African'' tournaments. Ahead of [[First_Strike/North_Africa/Strike_Arabia|First Strike]] he found himself on [[Fox Gaming]]. And although winning the qualifier, left the team ahead of the main event. ===Move to North America (2021-2022)=== Originally, Johnqt moved to Canada to finish his engineering degree. {{cite web|url=https://x.com/1johnqt/status/1619874171496062977|title=Moved randomly to Canada to finish my engineering degree and ended up achieving a long life dream by going pro instead, life is weird.|author='''Johnqt'''|date=2023-01-30}} However during his time there still ended up playing various tournaments in 2021, and ultimately was signed to [[Ghost Gaming]] at the start of 2022. {{cite web|url=https://x.com/GhostEsports/status/1482457770062331904|title=Introducing the official Ghost VALORANT roster!|author=[[Johnqt]]|date=2022-01-15}} ==Gallery== Ghost_Gaming_johnqt.png|johnqt with [[Ghost Gaming]] in 2022 ==References== {{Reflist}}
